shared_elements: schematic linear motifs with comb-like or toothed rows of short projections
abstract non-figural composition covering the field
justification: Both surfaces show abstract, non-naturalistic linear designs including rows of short parallel tines or teeth attached to a longer bar, and both use rectilinear stepped or ladder-like forms; that toothed-bar motif is the only mildly specific correspondence. The differences dominate: A is a sparse, thin-line composition of a few isolated comb-and-grid figures on an open field, whereas B is a dense, fully covered arrangement of curling volutes, spirals and interlocking scroll-and-panel forms with modelled relief, none of which appears in A.
